issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B logical operator signatures: And(left Boolean, right Boolean), Or(left Boolean, right Boolean), Xor(left Boolean, right Boolean), Implies(left Boolean, right Boolean), Not(argument Boolean)
issues.evidence: Before remediation, statically non-Boolean operands hidden by `as Any` translated to SQL truthiness, e.g. `(1 as Any) and true` -> `1 AND TRUE`, `(Code { code: 'x', system: 'urn:test' } as Any) or false` -> `json_object(...) OR FALSE`, and `(Interval[1, 2] as System.Any) and true` -> `intervalFromBounds(...) AND TRUE`.
issues.root_cause: _infer_static_cql_type_for_logical_operand returned the target type for all `as` expressions. For `as Any` / `as System.Any`, that erased statically known source types before logical operand validation.
issues.resolution: Logical operand type inference now unwraps `as Any` / `as System.Any` and validates the source expression type. Boolean sources through `as Any` remain valid; non-Boolean primitive, clinical, Quantity, List, Tuple, and Interval sources raise TranslationError.

issues.spec_citation: CQL Patient context retrieves are evaluated per subject; Appendix B logical operators inside query let/where/return must not leak rows across patients
issues.evidence: Before remediation, `singleton from ([Observation] O let High: O.value > 10, Final: O.status = 'final' where High implies Final return High xor Final)` generated count/value subqueries over all Observation rows instead of the current `_pt.patient_id`, so two patients with one Observation each produced NULL for both patients.
issues.root_cause: _apply_singleton_from() called the patient-correlation helper while `translate_library()` had not yet installed a patient alias. The helper returned the unmodified SELECT instead of using the deferred `_pt` alias that cte_manager later wraps around patient scalar expressions.
issues.resolution: The patient-correlation helper now falls back to `_pt` while translating Patient-context expressions, preserving existing cte_manager alias rewriting behavior and adding patient_id predicates to singleton-from query count/value subqueries.
